from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentMapping(BaseModel):
    """A single mapping between a document title and its legal cause category."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the document, e.g., '《判决文书1》'")
    cause_category: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause category the document belongs to, e.g., '婚姻家庭纠纷'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated extraction data from one or more documents for sorting."""
    mappings: list[DocumentMapping]
